checks.detail: Launch a minimal native Godot prototype with a simple bounded placeholder room, a player camera and ordinary keyboard/mouse input. This is an intentionally rough first increment: do not import the authored FPS map, real weapon or hand assets, HUD package, minimap package, enemy package or decorative asset collection. Verify the game starts without a black screen, missing-resource error or direct dependency on final content.

Use ordinary input to look and move the placeholder player inside the bounded prototype. Require stable camera framing, a visible floor, predictable input capture/release and a deterministic restart state. Placeholder geometry is permitted and expected; production scale, authored landmarks, weapons, HUD and map quality are explicitly out of scope.

Issue one narrow bootstrap verdict for the launchable placeholder loop. Accept only a real runnable shell and basic camera/input evidence; do not expand this first phase into map import, weapon implementation, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or final presentation.

Replace the accepted placeholder blockout with exactly one complete authored FPS environment from the asset pool. Launch through ordinary input and traverse its spawn-to-Alpha route. Require the PRD's 30-45 second effective spawn-to-A route budget with meaningful native cover and route decisions; reject moving Alpha close to spawn, shortening the route to make collision validation pass, or reporting a below-target route as acceptable. Require human-scale collision-backed ground, a fixed safe spawn, readable cover and landmarks, neutral daylight exposure, and no roof spawn, void, fall-through, decorative barriers, loose model placement or modular kit scatter. The authored map is first allowed in this phase; do not add real weapon/hand components, HUD, minimap or enemy AI yet.

Inspect the imported environment's complete native hierarchy, bounds, materials, collision and route datum. Require one intact instance supplying the dominant visible world, with product-owned outer support only. Reject extracted child meshes, broad proxy floors, cloned facades, missing textures, floating anchors, disconnected streets, raw-AABB minimap assumptions and source mutation.

Issue one map-integration verdict for the playable authored spawn-to-Alpha environment. The complete map, ground contact, collision, scale and route must be coherent in one ordinary-input run, and the route must preserve the PRD's 30-45 second effective travel budget rather than relocating Alpha to a trivial near-spawn endpoint. Do not require later weapon, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or cinematic behavior in this phase.

Pass. White-box review confirms normalized yaw-relative movement, grounded standing-only jump gating, stance-safe capsule resizing, bounded pitch, 76-degree FOV, physical-F6 reset, and no R reset binding. Fresh ordinary physical-key sequences exercised walk, strafe, sprint, crouch, jump, landing, mouse look, R, and F6. The state watch recorded crouched/standing and jump/landing transitions; initial and post-F6 digests agree at position (0,0.9,0), zero velocity, standing, grounded, 1.52 m camera height, 76-degree FOV, zero yaw/pitch, and captured mouse. Fresh frames retain human-scale daylight framing and intact geometry. Compared with the directional PRD image, daylight readability and first-person eye level are aligned; the missing weapon framing is judged separately.

Fail. main.tscn ends at an empty Camera3D, the candidate has no registered AK-74M/Saiga-12 component materialization or receipt, the live runtime search finds no Weapon node, and fresh gameplay frames show no gun, hands, rig, optic, muzzle, ADS, reload, or switching surface. This is a concrete gap from both the PRD image's weapon/hands framing and the required curated coupled-viewmodel contract.

Fail. project.godot defines locomotion and restart actions only; it has no fire, ADS, reload, weapon-switch, or fire-mode actions. The live state contains no weapon, ammo, shot, reload, hit, or feedback authority, the runtime tree has no Weapon node, and fresh frames show no combat feedback. None of the required AK-74M/Saiga-12 causal scenarios is reachable through ordinary input.

Issue one integrated weapon-foundation verdict for the accepted map and real weapon/hand components. Preserve the map and movement while proving the player-to-weapon causal chain. HUD skinning, minimap, enemy AI and final UI remain later work.

required_criteria.requirement: Use ordinary keyboard and mouse input to walk, strafe, sprint, crouch, jump and look across the accepted authored spawn-to-Alpha route. Preserve human scale, stable ground contact, collision-safe movement, readable camera height and FOV, and no shimmer, missing surfaces or exposure changes caused by camera movement.

Integrate the supplied AK-74M and Saiga-12 first-person components with their real hands/arms and animation rigs. Require plausible human scale, correct forward axis, two-hand contact, stable camera-relative framing, muzzle and optic alignment, weapon switching, ADS and reload visibility without clipping. Do not replace an intact component with a weaker reconstruction.

Through ordinary input, demonstrate AK-74M single and automatic fire, Saiga-12 fire, weapon switch, ADS, tactical/empty reload, dry fire, blocked shot, miss and controlled target hit. One authoritative shot event must drive ammo, recoil, animation, muzzle/impact feedback and audio exactly once. Do not build HUD, minimap or enemy AI yet; minimal world-space feedback is sufficient.
